edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns _owner from _msgSender().
MetaInu constructor assigns _taxWallet = payable(_msgSender()), granting the caller tax-collector authority.
transfer() forwards msg.sender as the 'from' argument to _transfer.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
onlyTaxCollector requires _taxWallet == msg.sender before lowerTax executes.
onlyTaxCollector requires _taxWallet == msg.sender before removeBuyLimit executes.
onlyTaxCollector gates the privileged mint in grant.
onlyTaxCollector gates the privileged airdrop loop.
onlyTaxCollector gates privileged pair creation.
onlyTaxCollector gates privileged liquidity addition and trading enablement.
onlyTaxCollector gates the manual tax swap.
onlyTaxCollector gates the manual ETH collection.
onlyTaxCollector gates whitelist additions.
onlyTaxCollector gates whitelist removals.
onlyOwner requires _owner == msg.sender before renounceOwnership executes.
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline, a miner-influenceable parameter.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
renounceOwnership reads and clears _owner.
_taxFee is passed as the taxRate argument to _tokenTransfer.
lowerTax writes _taxFee, letting the tax collector change transfer economics.
_maxTxAmount bounds the buy amount inside _transfer.
removeBuyLimit overwrites _maxTxAmount with _tTotal.
grant increases _tTotal with SafeMath add, allowing unbounded minting.
_tTotal/balance is approved before creating the pair in addLiquidity flow.
_tokenTransfer reads and writes _balance for sender, recipient and contract.
grant directly mutates _balance of the recipient.
_isExcludedFromFee decides who bypasses fees and buy limits in _transfer.
addToWhitelist sets _isExcludedFromFee[buyer] = true.
removeFromWhitelist sets _isExcludedFromFee[buyer] = false.
lockTheSwap toggles _inSwap around the external router swap call.
_swapEnabled controls whether _transfer triggers an automatic swap.
createUniswapPair requires !_canTrade before pair creation.
_pair is compared against from/to to detect buys and sells.
swapTokensForEth queries _uniswap.WETH() and performs the swap.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][msg.sender] before subtracting.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transfer() calls _transfer(msg.sender, recipient, amount).
transferFrom calls _transfer(sender, recipient, amount).
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
_transfer ends by delegating balance mutation to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth on the contract token balance when swaps are enabled.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH to the tax wallet when the balance exceeds TAX_THRESHOLD.
require condition reads the external amount() value to gate non-exempt transfers.
_transfer computes contractTokenBalance = balanceOf(address(this)).
contractTokenBalance is passed as the swap amount.
contractETHBalance is the value forwarded to sendETHToFee.
External router call executes while the transfer is still in progress.
swapTokensForEth calls _approve for the router before swapping.
Raw ETH transfer to _taxWallet can invoke arbitrary receive logic.
swapForTax re-enters swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
swapForTax stores balanceOf(address(this)) in contractBalance.
collectTax forwards the whole contract ETH balance to sendETHToFee.
collectTax reads address(this).balance into contractETHBalance.
createUniswapPair calls the factory createPair externally.
createUniswapPair calls approve on the newly created pair externally.
addLiquidity forwards the whole contract ETH balance to the router while state is partially updated.
grant mints by adding to _balance[recipient] and _tTotal.
airdrop loops calling _tokenTransfer from the contract to each recipient.
_tokenTransfer subtracts and adds amounts in _balance using SafeMath.
_tokenTransfer computes tTransferAmount from tAmount and tTeam.
_transfer.from parameter drives the exemption, pair and owner comparisons.
_transfer.to parameter drives buy-limit and exemption checks.
_transfer.amount is bounded by the buy limit and the external amount() gate.
_tokenTransfer.sender is the debited account.
_tokenTransfer.recipient is the credited account.
_tokenTransfer.tAmount is the gross amount split into tax and transfer.
_tokenTransfer.taxRate determines the taxed portion.
tTeam = tAmount.mul(taxRate).div(100).
taxRate multiplies the amount to produce the tax portion.
tTransferAmount = tAmount.sub(tTeam).
tokenAmount is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
newTaxRate must satisfy require(newTaxRate < INITIAL_TAX) before writing _taxFee.
grant.recipient receives the minted balance.
grant.amount is added to balance and total supply.
airdrop.recipients provides iteration targets.
airdrop.amount is transferred to each recipient.
whitelist.buyer is granted fee exemption.
whitelist.buyer loses fee exemption.
swapTokensForEth.path is the swap route [token, WETH].
airdrop.len bounds the loop.
airdrop.i indexes the recipients array.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter 'from' of _transfer exists only to feed the transfer logic and is normalized into the function node.
Parameter 'to' of _transfer only parameterizes the same transfer logic.
Parameter 'amount' of _transfer only parameterizes the same transfer logic.
Parameter 'sender' belongs solely to _tokenTransfer.
Parameter 'recipient' belongs solely to _tokenTransfer.
Parameter 'tAmount' belongs solely to _tokenTransfer.
Parameter 'taxRate' belongs solely to _tokenTransfer.
Parameter 'tokenAmount' is consumed only by swapTokensForEth.
Parameter 'newTaxRate' is consumed only by lowerTax.
Parameter 'recipient' is consumed only by grant.
Parameter 'amount' is consumed only by grant.
Parameter 'recipients' is consumed only by airdrop.
Parameter 'amount' is consumed only by airdrop.
Parameter 'buyer' feeds the whitelist mutation functions addToWhitelist and removeFromWhitelist.
Local 'contractTokenBalance' is derived inside _transfer.
Local 'contractETHBalance' of _transfer is the argument passed to sendETHToFee.
Local 'tTeam' is the intermediate tax value computed inside _tokenTransfer.
Local 'tTransferAmount' is the net amount computed inside _tokenTransfer.
Local 'path' is built and used only by swapTokensForEth.
Local 'len' caches the array length inside airdrop.
Local 'i' is the airdrop loop index.
Local 'contractBalance' is read and swapped only in swapForTax.
Local 'contractETHBalance' is read and forwarded only in collectTax.
